scope: Independent direct inspection of all 24 original JPEG screenshots from the exact CI artifact loopback capture. Pre-publication build pixel acceptance only.
independentPixelFindings: Telephone 1844-0644 and the expected three banner headings/supporting copy were readable in all 18 targeted screenshots.
No targeted banner was visibly clipped, distorted, stretched or covered by native header/order controls.
Home, representative article and directory layouts remained visually coherent in both widths.
The removed common AI-generated-image caption was not visible around any of the targeted banners.

supplementalMachineEvidence.source: capture-results.json, not a claim of manual pixel coverage

limitations: Full-page images were displayed as scaled layout overviews; this was not complete body-text proofreading at native size.
Only the three selected routes were manually viewed, at the two captured widths; all other routes have separate DOM/static evidence.
No browser interaction, keyboard navigation, anchor landing, expanded disclosure, telephone click or external link destination was tested in this screenshot review.
Upper/lower portions of surrounding content can be outside the viewport in targeted captures because the browser scrolled to the banner. This is not a target-banner clipping defect.
Exact public deployment bytes, real public HTTP, and IndexNow receipt require separate checks.
